title: Nourishing Smoky Russian English Muffin Kebabs
description: A hearty, smoky Russian dish featuring English muffins, perfect for a lazy Sunday, cooked in a tagine pot on a robata grill, with a bitter and shattering flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread toasted English muffin cubes onto skewers.
In a bowl, mix together cream cheese, smoked salmon, chopped fresh dill, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the English muffin cubes with butter.
Place the skewers in the tagine pot and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot with the cream cheese and smoked salmon mixture on top.
Garnish with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes if the English muffins are not toasted enough.
